g.text: Session lifecycle — the states a session can be in
planner runs the night before · six stages inside a live session · pause/end/drop all counted properly · R-SE-1..10
stage 4 · Core practice — upgrade loop (R-UL) — 15 min
stage 5 · Recap — the 3 items that return next (R-RC-2) — 6 min
each stage → fresh Gemini context + handover notes (D-046)
